pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: lib/turns/assemble/research.ts:135 The retrieval prompt's tool list is written by hand instead of being built from RETRIEVE_TOOLS (lib/text/providers/claudeCliRetrieve.ts:61), so the prompt and the dispatcher learn the roster from two places and can drift apart. That is the capability-drift failure the standard exists to prevent.

techniques.evidence: lib/turns/assemble/research.ts:135 The tool list is hand-written next to an existing RETRIEVE_TOOLS constant. There is a second case: frames.ts:42 injects pipeline/FRAMES-SCENE-PROMPT.md:3 verbatim, which tells a tool-less run (claudeCli.ts:285-286) to read two files it cannot open.

lib/turns/kinds/recalibrate.ts:102 Each family has one pure assembler built from named blocks (manifest.ts joinBlocks), but the assembled string is not sealed. lib/text/router.ts:437 appends schemaInstruction after assembly, outside the manifest and the digest, and the schema is already in the RUN block.

lib/turns/assemble/manifest.ts:60 An absent input renders as an empty string under its heading (SCOPE; frames NOTEBOOK when facts is absent). This is kept on purpose for byte parity; it is the empty-success render the technique forbids.

lib/turns/ledger.ts:98 The record holds a digest and size of the whole prompt, payload included, so no record stamps which version of RECALIBRATE-PROMPT.md or FRAMES-SCENE-PROMPT.md a turn received. It is also 'as built', so it misses the router's appended schema block.

lib/turns/assemble/frames.ts:65 The ceiling is counted in characters converted to tokens by an assumed ratio, and it is not derived from the window minus the response reservation. Per-block sizes in the manifest and the named 'NOT SENT' cuts do conform.
lib/turns/assemble/recalibrate.ts:116 Material the tool-less engine cannot reach is kept as a floor; only slices no beat can cite are cut.
lib/agent/reviewerEngines.ts:65 A locate pointer, a permission fact and a done criterion stated as an artifact, with no role priming.
lib/turns/assemble/frames.ts:125 Assembly is pure and reads no clock; a search for new Date, Date.now, toISOString and today in lib/turns/assemble found nothing.
lib/turns/assemble/recalibrate.ts:12 The CLI rung has no cross-call prompt caching, so there are no cut points to allocate.
lib/claudeCli.ts:286 Reasoning turns are single-shot; the client keeps no transcript to compact.
lib/agent/agentArgs.ts:44 Agent turns keep no session, so no stored assistant turn is ever replayed.
lib/agent/agentArgs.ts:37 safe-mode turns off CLAUDE.md, skills and plugins, so no installed document is admitted.
lib/agent/cliSeam.ts:3 One prompt in, one answer out; the client neither holds nor edits a message list.
lib/agent/reviewerCommand.ts:22 Reviewer runs are ephemeral, and no foreign-harness history is imported.
lib/turns/ledger.ts:32 An interrupted turn is marked orphaned, never resumed.
lib/turns/assemble/recalibrate.ts:187 Measured prompts are about 40k characters, far below the window, so the input side is not under pressure (the technique's own when-not clause).
